title: Set-valued sheafification exists for a small sieve topology
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal D$ be a $\mathcal V$-small category and $J$ a Grothendieck topology given by covering sieves as in [def-weil-pbc-topos]. Put $\operatorname{PSh}(\mathcal D)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Sets}_{\mathcal V})$, and let $i:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,J;\operatorname{Sets}_{\mathcal V})\to\operatorname{PSh}(\mathcal D)$ be the full inclusion. There is a functor $a:\operatorname{PSh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,J;\operatorname{Sets}_{\mathcal V})$ left adjoint to $i$. Its unit $\eta_P:P\to i(aP)$ is natural in $P$, and precomposition with $\eta_P$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(aP,F)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(P,iF)$ for every presheaf $P$ and every $J$-sheaf $F$. Thus $aP$, also denoted $P^\#$, is sheafification in the universal-property sense of [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. No pullbacks in $\mathcal D$ are assumed.
